source_claims.quote: The Greeks represented the sphinx as a winged lioness with a woman's head.

statement.id: Orang Yunani menggambarkannya sebagai singa betina bersayap dan berkepala perempuan.
statement.en: Greek art portrayed the sphinx as a winged lioness with a woman's head.

source_claims.quote: She was sent by the gods to plague the town of Thebes as punishment for some ancient crime, preying on its youths and devouring all who failed to solve her riddle.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, para dewa mengirim Sphinx untuk menimpakan bencana pada kota Thebes sebagai hukuman atas kejahatan lama; ia memangsa para pemuda dan melahap semua yang gagal memecahkan teka-tekinya.
statement.en: According to Theoi, the gods sent the Sphinx to plague the town of Thebes as punishment for some ancient crime; she preyed on its youths and devoured all who failed to solve her riddle.

source_claims.quote: For Hera sent the Sphinx, ... whose mother was Echidna and her father Typhon; and she had the face of a woman, the breast and feet and tail of a lion, and the wings of a bird.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Hera mengirim Sphinx, yang ibunya Echidna dan ayahnya Typhon; ia berwajah perempuan, berdada, berkaki, dan berekor singa, serta bersayap burung.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Hera sent the Sphinx, whose mother was Echidna and father Typhon; she had a woman's face, a lion's breast, feet, and tail, and a bird's wings.
